description: Live frontend previews for Umbraco 17/18 Block List blocks in the backoffice: each block shows its real Razor partial, rendered with the site's own CSS and JavaScript in a sandboxed, auto-sized iframe that updates as the editor types. Also ships configurable video and code preview elements.

RESTful Service API for Dynamicweb 10 administration: CRUD endpoints for products, variants, stock, prices, orders, shops, users and more under /admin/serviceapi, with OpenAPI documentation. Installs as an add-in; API updates hot-reload without an application recycle. Requires Dynamicweb 10.25.7 or…
The server side of PulseSharp sync: an ASP.NET Core endpoint that receives events from devices and sends them the server's events.
Device to cloud sync for PulseSharp: the device keeps working offline and sends its events to the server, and receives the server's events, when it is online. No dependencies beyond PulseSharp.
Extension methods for everyday .NET types: validation, conversion and manipulation helpers for arrays, booleans, strings, dates, enums, GUIDs, objects, types and more.
Hangfire integration for Blueprint background and recurring tasks.
A typed HTTP client for calling Blueprint APIs using their operation types.
Marten integration for Blueprint: a unit of work for generated pipelines and domain-event dispatch from Marten sessions.
